A huge boiler: per block of height it holds 100,000 HU, boils with up to 600 HU/t and holds 16,000 mB of water and steam. Its big drum uses 20% less heat per mB.
Build a hollow 3x3 tower, 3 to 7 tall. The corners must be casings; anywhere else can be Pressure Glass, so you can watch the water and steam inside.
